semantics.exact_statement: For the typed O(3) representation sigma -> R sigma R^T, beta -> R beta, omega -> det(R) R omega, the registered twelve polynomials have the declared scalar or pseudoscalar parity. Every real trace-free 3 by 3 sigma obeys sigma^3 - tr(sigma^2) sigma/2 - tr(sigma^3) I/3 = 0 and the registered beta-beta, omega-omega, and beta-omega contractions. det[beta,sigma beta,sigma^2 beta]^2 equals the Gram determinant. The fixed beta=0, omega versus -omega pair has identical registered polynomial values, so neither generic orbit separation nor invariant-ring completeness is promoted.

symbol_type_domain_map.R: real orthogonal 3 by 3 matrix with determinant plus or minus one
symbol_type_domain_map.K_beta: 3 by 3 matrix with columns beta, sigma beta, sigma^2 beta

frame_signature_units_conventions.parity: sigma STF even, beta polar, omega axial

assumptions: sigma is real, symmetric, and trace-free
R^T R equals the identity and det(R) is plus or minus one
beta and omega share the registered Cartesian basis with sigma
all polynomial comparisons use one frame, epoch/window, and perturbative order
exclusions: No generic orbit separation theorem is asserted.
No invariant-ring or degree completeness theorem is asserted.
No inverse morphology atlas, source attribution, or Bianchi family identification is asserted.
The four reflection-odd quantities are pseudoscalars, not O(3) invariants.
singular_loci: beta=0 makes every beta-containing polynomial vanish and supplies the registered non-separation witness
repeated sigma eigenvalues can enlarge the stabilizer and are outside any unproved generic-separation language
boundary_or_initial_conditions: fixed exact witness sigma=diag(1,2,-3), beta=(1,1,1), omega=(1,2,3)
fixed non-separation witness beta=0, omega=(1,2,3) versus omega=(-1,-2,-3)

target.canonical_form: Exact integer polynomial values, exact matrix identities, Boolean parity checks, and explicit UNPROVEN nonpromotion states.
target.equivalence_relation: exact equality over integers and polynomial identities over the declared real domain
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not read another axis script, derivation, or result before submitting.
Do not call every registered polynomial an O(3) invariant.
Do not infer generic separation from finite test vectors.
Do not infer invariant-ring completeness from Cayley-Hamilton reductions.
Do not replace the axial omega action by the polar beta action.
Do not promote the non-separation witness into a physical source or family statement.

wolfram_xact.obligation: Independent exact verification in Wolfram Language; load xAct and record its version while keeping the computation in exact scalar and matrix algebra.

sympy.obligation: Independent exact symbolic verification in SymPy.

sage_singular.obligation: Independent exact verification in SageMath with the Singular version recorded.

lean.obligation: Faithful theorem formalization and compiled exact fixture proof under formal/lean-toolchain.

independence.script_result_ownership: per-axis; scripts and outputs are never shared before parent-owned run-adjudicate execution
independence.correlation_disclosure: record when one LLM family authored multiple axis scripts; engine agreement is not derivation independence

exceptions_adjudication.aggregate_status_rule: R3 requires CAS_4AXIS_PASS; majority vote is forbidden
